scientific_integrity: A complete unrestricted mathematical argument is supplied, plus a separate finite literal-factor checker at k=2..10. Finite tests are not treated as infinite proof; there is no independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Classification of distinct factors at binary Thue-Morse dyadic lengths 2^k, k>=2, for 2-Abelian equivalence only. No occurrence-weighted frequencies, non-dyadic lengths, or higher-order equivalence. Historical priority not independently certified. The proof cites the established ordinary factor-complexity formula at dyadic lengths.
title: Dyadic two-Abelian ambiguity spectra of Thue–Morse factors
